description: This Java source file defines the `BluetoothChatFragment` class, which manages Bluetooth communication within an Android app. It handles Bluetooth setup, connection, message sending and receiving, and UI updates related to Bluetooth chat functionality.

classes.name: BluetoothChatFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that manages Bluetooth connection and chat activity, including UI components, connection handling, message transmission, and state updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets menu options, and obtains the Bluetooth adapter.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Checks Bluetooth state; prompts user to enable Bluetooth if disabled, and sets up chat.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources by stopping Bluetooth chat service if active.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts Bluetooth chat service if it isn't already running.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components after view creation.

methods.name: setupChat
methods.description: Configures the chat UI and initializes Bluetooth chat service.

methods.name: ensureDiscoverable
methods.description: Makes the device discoverable for Bluetooth connections.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message over Bluetooth if connected.

methods.name: mWriteListener
methods.description: Listener for the input field to send messages when user presses return.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Updates the action bar subtitle with connection status.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Processes messages received from the Bluetooth service, updating UI accordingly.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles results from Bluetooth enable/connection activities.

methods.name: connectDevice
methods.description: Initiates connection to a selected Bluetooth device.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates menu options for Bluetooth connection control.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for Bluetooth operations.
